title: 2026-07-28's skill-registry 'fix' never worked -- .claude/settings.json's "skills" key is not a schema Claude Code reads at all
notes: harness_skill_registry_repair_20260728 (status: confirmed, verdict: verified) claimed the registry was fixed by pointing .claude/settings.json's "skills" array at .agents/skills/<name>, verified via 'registered=13, REGISTERED-BUT-MISSING=0, all 13 resolve to an existing SKILL.md'. That check only confirmed the FILES EXIST on disk -- it never tested whether the harness's project-skill loader actually reads a "skills" key from settings.json. It does not: Claude Code's project-skill loader only reads .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md. The "skills" array is not a recognized settings schema key and is silently ignored.

RECEIPT (falsifying the prior 'fix'): two Skill tool_use invocations in real transcripts both failed with <tool_use_error>Unknown skill: X</tool_use_error> -- match-my-writing-style (D--workspace-omission/54445130-.../line 1780) and progress-review-plan (D--workspace-omission/5b285287-.../line 11031). Both names were present and 'verified' in the 2026-07-28 node at the time of these failures.

Corrected 2026-07-31: copied all 14 skill directories from .agents/skills/<name> to .claude/skills/<name> (the real loading location) and removed the dead "skills" key from .claude/settings.json (file is now {}). .agents/skills/<name> left in place unchanged, since AGENTS.md/CONTEXT.md/jnwb/README.md and other docs still reference it as the source location -- .claude/skills/ is a copy for the loader, not a move, so the two can drift; a future pass should decide whether to make .agents/skills/ a pointer/symlink instead of a duplicate.

VERIFIED LIVE, same day, next turn: the new turn's available-skills system-reminder listed all 13 remaining project skills (jnwb-core/spiking/tfr/statistics/visualization/functional-connectivity/jrsa/population/metadata, nwb-analysis-forms, labyrinth-protocol, docx-editing, match-my-writing-style) by name with their real descriptions -- direct confirmation the .claude/skills/ copy loads correctly. This IS the cross-turn verification the earlier note deferred; upgrading verdict to verified below.

Also 2026-07-31 (same session as verification): deleted progress-review-plan entirely (both .claude/skills/ and .agents/skills/ copies) -- inspected its full content and confirmed it was a pure redirect stub to labyrinth-protocol with zero unique information (just a deprecation notice and file-path pointers), so removing it loses nothing and cuts one dead entry from the skill listing. Updated .agents/AGENTS.md's skill table: removed the stale 'Backlog / PRP -> progress-review-plan' row, added the missing 'match-my-writing-style' row, and added a note that .claude/skills/ (not .agents/skills/) is where the loader actually reads from.
issues: Duplication risk remains for the other 13 skills: .agents/skills/<name> and .claude/skills/<name> are two independent copies. If either is edited without the other, they drift. Not resolved this turn -- flagged for a future Adapt pass (symlink or single-source-of-truth decision).
plan: Decide whether .agents/skills/ should become a symlink to .claude/skills/ (single source) or be retired in favor of doc updates pointing at .claude/skills/ directly.

verification.receipt: Two failed Skill tool_use invocations in real transcripts directly falsified the 2026-07-28 node's 'verified' verdict. The 2026-07-31 fix (copy to .claude/skills/) was then confirmed live: the very next turn's system-reminder skill listing enumerated all 13 remaining project skills by name and full description, which only happens if the harness actually loaded them from .claude/skills/.

links.reasoning: That node's 'verified'/'confirmed' status rested on a check (paths resolve on disk) that does not establish the thing actually being claimed (the harness loads project skills from this registration). Two real failed invocations postdate that node's claimed fix and directly falsify it.
